integrity.proof_type: parameter-uniform analytic Rayleigh certificates with complete optimizer equality analysis

scientific_limitations: The result covers only a four-vertex undirected cycle with one exceptional positive edge-price parameter; it does not address arbitrary cycles or discrete-time spectral-radius objectives.
The algebraic claims are proved analytically; exact finite replay is only supplemental.
Claims of publication priority remain conditional on the inspected evidence and have not been independently assessed.
title: Exact cost-driven edge deletion and Fiedler multiplicity on a four-cycle
